sources.snippet: Today, we are excited to introduce the latest addition to the Qwen family: Qwen2.5. Dense, easy-to-use, decoder-only language models, available in 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B sizes, and base and instruct variants. Pretrained on our latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18T tokens.

sources.title: Qwen
sources.snippet: We are launching Qwen-Image-3.0, the third-generation foundational image generation model in the Qwen-Image series. If the keyword for Qwen-Image-1. was "Precision", and the keywords for Qwen-Image-2. were "Precision, Variety, Completeness, Beauty, and Authenticity", then the core of Qwen-Image-3. comes down to a single word — "Real" (实).
